title: Rollout control strategy
request: Compare the two equally relevant rollout approaches in visible evidence. Neither is declared more correct. Return a FinalAnswer Decision whose primary_evidence_id is exactly causal-rollout-a or causal-rollout-b and whose final_choice is exactly shadow_adaptation or canary_rollback. Do not use tools.

mechanism.reasoning_guidance: When multiple equally relevant approaches exist, give greater initial consideration to novel alternatives and cross-domain options before converging.

evidence.content: Novel alternative evidence R-35: shadow traffic compares candidate behavior without serving its output, then adjusts routing from observed divergence. Exposure can expand incrementally after each observation window. Recommended choice id: shadow_adaptation.

Risk precedent R-10: a broad rollout previously amplified a rare failure before detection. A bounded canary with explicit rollback thresholds limits exposure and preserves reversibility. Recommended choice id: canary_rollback.
